reviews.text: Best experience ever. Outstanding customer service. Very helpful and they speak Spanish and English so I didn’t have an issue communicating with their staff. Thank you.

I'm so happy to have my baby treated at this clinic. The treatment is always very special; every time we go, we avoid causing him stress, and he always comes home very happy, which says a lot about the care and love he receives.
Thank you for the medical care provided by the clinic staff. I'm very grateful to Geysel for treating my pet so well. This clinic is highly recommended; it's one of the best I've visited.
Thank you so much for the medical care provided by the staff at this clinic. I'm very grateful to Geysel; she took excellent care of my pet. Highly recommended clinic.

I had a wonderful experience at Hialeah Animal Clinic. The clinic is very clean, welcoming, and well organized, and they are always respectful of appointment times. The staff is friendly, caring, and attentive, and they treated my dog with so much patience and kindness. I really appreciate the gentle and mindful way they handled him and made sure he was comfortable throughout the visit. It’s reassuring to know my dog is in such caring hands. Highly recommend! 🐾❤️

My kitten is going through an allergy problem, and from the very first moment, the entire staff treated us incredibly well, with so much kindness, patience, and care.

I especially want to thank Natalia, who was very attentive to my kitten and followed up with her throughout the entire process. You can tell when someone truly cares about the animals and the peace of mind of their owners.

I am very grateful to the whole team for the attention and treatment they gave us. I definitely recommend Hialeah Animal Clinic without hesitation.

I took my kitten to the vet at a very difficult time, as his advanced age had left him quite ill. My cat is usually very wary and distrustful of strangers, so I was very worried about how he would react during his appointments and treatment.

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to the veterinarian and, especially, to Natalia for the wonderful care she provided. With the patience, gentleness, and love with which Natalia treated him, my kitten managed to remain calm throughout, which I found truly incredible. Thanks to the professional and dedicated care he received, my four-legged companion is now much better.

I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone looking for professionalism and, above all, genuine empathy towards our pets. Thank you so much for everything!

I have no words to express my gratitude for the work they did for my baby at Hialeah Animal Clinic. I am so grateful to the entire team at the clinic. They treated my kitten with so much love, patience, and professionalism. The place is always spotless, and the veterinarians explain everything clearly. I recommend this place 100%. I especially want to thank Natalia because she was always very attentive to my baby's progress and is such a kind person with animals. 💕

😁😺 Thank you, Geysel, for the wonderful care you gave my cat at Hialeah Animal Clinic! Your love and patience with animals is evident. I left feeling very reassured, knowing my kitty was in the best hands. Thank you! …

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to Hialeah Animal Clinic for the wonderful care they provided to my baby, Maya. The love, dedication, and passion with which each of their staff members cares for our little ones is evident. A very special thank you to Natalia for being so sweet, loving, and kind to my baby, Maya. Thank you for making him feel so loved and for treating him with such care. I am eternally grateful to the entire team!
